revision_summary: No fabricated quotes were found and the core trajectory read (tentative/conditional booking, fragile appointment) is well-supported and should be preserved. Two targeted fixes for rerun: (1) In cherry_pick_moments[4] (ts 01:09), replace the invalid schema_reference 'script_coverage.address_homeowner' \u2014 this is not a real schema path; Stage 3 is citing its own output key as if it were an Ion schema section. Use 'verify.items.address_homeowner_confirmed' or mark schema_reference as null since this is really just confirming an existing record, not a fresh verify pass. (2) Add a brief flag for the confusing role/legitimacy exchange at 00:05-00:08 ('Yes. This is for Ion Solar?' / 'Yeah. Yeah. This is Ion Solar.') \u2014 this is the clearest textual signal of the unusual speaker dynamic in this reversed-role call and should be explicitly named in starting_state or a missed_moments-style note rather than left implicit. Also soften observed_outcome.appointment_channel's 'in_person' tag to acknowledge uncertainty (add a caveat noting Ion setter calls are normally phone appointments per button_up.phone_appointment_specified, and the 'driving out here' reference may indicate a closer site-visit rather than a standard phone slot) rather than stating it as a flat fact.
